profile.name: 工业相机
profile.description: 一种用于实验成像和机器视觉采集的数字相机，可连续或触发采集图像，并可调曝光时间、增益、帧率、像素格式和采集区域，常用于显微观察、定位检测和通用视觉测量。
profile.description_en: A digital machine-vision camera for laboratory imaging and visual data acquisition. It supports continuous or triggered image capture and allows adjustment of exposure time, gain, frame rate, pixel format, and acquisition region, making it suitable for microscopy, alignment, inspection, and general imaging measurements.

registry.description: Camera是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括停止、写入数据、加载、启动、增益设置、执行。支持Signal, Slot, create buffers等操作。
